description: ODC: the REFUSAL of the delete of a structure used as a type. WfCovAddress is the type of the input Address of WfCovQuote_Build and of the nested attribute WfCovPolicyQuote.Address; without force the delete is refused and the message names the consumers (6: the input, the nested attribute and the expressions that read the fields; the anonymous record `WfCovAddress Record` no longer counts while nobody uses it, and a consumer inside another is not repeated; the order changes between runs, so only the count and the two stable paths are expected). The clean path (repoint with replace and delete the source without force) is in tests/jobs-odc/structure-refactor.json.
